name: Union Commonwealth University
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts university founded in 1879 as Union College, described as the first college founded in the Kentucky mountains; core affiliation with Methodism. Serves students from throughout Appalachia and nationally. Notable programs include the Edna Jenkins Mann School of Nursing, Educational Studies, Psychology, and Health Sciences, with undergraduate, graduate, and online offerings.
financial_aid: University reports 100% of undergraduate students receiving scholarships or aid (2026-2027, unionky.edu cost-aid pages). Interest-free monthly payment plans available (12-month annual or 6-month fall/spring options). 2026-2027 comprehensive fee $2,400/year.
